'''Karydee''' was a manufacturer of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. They produced the [[KD49 repulsorlift drive unit|KD49 repulsorlift engine]], which was incorporated into the [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]], and the [[KD57 3-chamber repulsorlift engine]], which was used in most [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barges]], such as [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']].
